name: fio-3.43
body:
## What's Changed
* helper_thread: Handle EINTR errno from select() by @alex310110 in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2079
* Support write overlap numberio verification when io_size > size by @minwooim in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2074
* verify: fix segfault in timedout teardown by @minwooim in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2081
* fio: prevent OOM by not allocating buffer for TRIM range by @dennischerchang in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2069
* Fix that the function libzbc_report_zones fails prematurely when encountering SOBR zone types if using libzbc engine by @rorychen in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2083
* cgroup: fix path buffer overflows for long cgroup names by @linuxholic in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2085
* t/io_uring: add --hugetlb option for hugetlbfs IO buffers by @ming1 in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2088
* init: fix memory leaks reported by LeakSanitizer by @malikoyv in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2090
* verify: skip errored WRITE offset in verify by @minwooim in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2086
* backend: remove linux/prctl.h include to fix musl conflict by @lucashecht in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2097
* engines/nvme: fix addr/data_len for no data nvme commands by @swarnagh6 in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2101
* blktrace: fix three bugs in merge_blktrace_iologs path by @wangxp006 in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2099
* doc: indicate that metadata options are supported with io_uring by @calebsander in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2104
* Introduce crash-aware data verification by @minwooim in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2091
* Io uring/multiple write modes by @minwooim in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2089
* backend: log trim @io_u to io_hist even `do_verify=0` by @minwooim in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2105
* io_uring: register ring fd and reduce code duplication by @calebsander in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2108
* verify: fix bandwidth asymmetry and memory leak with norandommap by @malikoyv in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2107
* engines/io_uring: Introduce BSG io uring cmd by @ljw8161 in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2102
* io_uring: Add support for 'zone_append' when using uring_cmd and zonemode ZBD by @Krien in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2103
* Implement Sequence Distribution feature with Striding by @vadlakondaswetha in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2094
* server: properly reap child processes on SIGINT to prevent assertion crash by @cenhuil in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2109
* iolog: size pending log larger than iodepth to avoid log assertion by @SAY-5 in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2115
* Fix a few recent Coverity complaints by @bvanassche in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2116
* parse: ignore leading minus sign when splitting options by @cenhuil in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2112
* stop experimental verify based on bytes issued, not completed by @malikoyv in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2118
* engines/io_uring: add copyright header to bsg files by @ljw8161 in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2125
* engines: add ROCm hipFile engine via shared gpuaccel layer by @sbates130272 in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2113
* libnfs only requires gnutls on Linux by @bsdkurt in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2135
* engines/io_uring_cmd: extend bsg cmd_type with cdb_len, verify, and prefetch by @ljw8161 in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2123
* doc: change RWF_UNCACHED to RWF_DONTCACHE by @Panky-codes in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2138
* backend: exit non-zero when a job process is killed by a signal by @Vladyyy in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2129
* verify: dump the received buffer when zero verify fails by @sarthak-k in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2140
* Consolidate all caller of io_ops_commit() to call td_io_commit() by @dennischerchang in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2139
* Fixes: #2142 inconsistent type of convert_agg_kbytes_percent()'s caller by @dennischerchang in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2143
* README: fix unclosed angle bracket in maintainer email by @vic233333 in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2147
* Remove metadata transfer from Data Transfer 00b commands by @sc108-lee in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2145
